title: Manifest's mechanical word-count proof reports 426 raw/425 unique for NEVER_A_PERSON; the true figures (comment-stripped extraction) are 422 raw/421 unique. The manifest's counter pulled 4 quoted strings out of the block's // and /* */ doc comments as if they were Set entries. The byte-identical before/after conclusion is unaffected -- verified independently by the checker with a comment-aware extractor, same result on both sides of the move -- but the stated counts would mislead a future reader, and 421 is also the figure that reconciles with closed-class-audit-words.json's totals (421 - 12 excludedCollectiveAddress = 409).
evidence: packages/index/src/pipeline/speaker-name-data.ts NEVER_A_PERSON block; checker's comment-stripping re-extraction gave 422 raw / 421 unique on both merge-base (116e2fe) and post-change (9642873) copies; qa/manifests/speaker-rules-data-module-extraction.md 'Mechanical proof of zero word-data change' section states 426/425
